name: chad-review
description: 6-pass autonomous pre-commit code review: drift, behavior-and-risk, tests, observability, dependency-freshness, and simplification, on uncommitted working-tree changes (or the last commit if clean). Every sub-check still reports or marks itself N/A, so spec drift, codegen staleness, and doc rot stay individually visible. Diff-shape aware: light and deps-only diffs skip the fan-out entirely. Tuned for Claude Opus 5: one reviewer per language block plus one whole-project freshness agent (2 sub-agents, not 3), sub-agents report every finding with a confidence tag while the parent filters once with all findings in view, and session-relative sonnet/opus tiering pins an explicit model on every launch. Read-only on the diff and never commits; it backs up untracked files before the fan-out and restores any that vanish during the review, because the read-only guarantee is prompt-enforced rather than tool-enforced.
